notes.title: Version 0.20.0
notes.notes:
New features and stuff:


Lobby chat and game chat.

Some visual enhancements to the game map.

Bugfixes.

notes.title: Version 0.19.0
notes.notes: Small tweaks here and there and most notably finally added number groups to units.

notes.title: Version 0.18.3
notes.notes:
Lots of new stuff:

New unit: Medic. Heal those troops so they can get back to lasering.

New building: Supply Depot. Get those supplies to you faster so you can invest that precious LC to the war effort.

Reworked the networking code in some places and removed stupid things. Now everything runs nice and smooth even if the latency is a little bit under 200ms! (Who plays in lobbies where the latency is so high?)

Fixed a few bugs here and there.

notes.title: Version 0.17.5
notes.notes:
Hotfix 5 changelog:


Fixed another game crashing bug with unit movement.

Tweaked the current one and only game map a bit to fix balance.

notes.title: Version 0.17.4
notes.notes:
Lots of general improvements and additions in version 0.17. 

Hotfix 4 fixes an annoying fatal bug that was caught during playtesting.

notes.title: Version 0.16.0
notes.notes: Lots of cool stuff including a proper main menu finally and lobby listings. Everything is subject to change but it looks good IMO.

notes.title: Version 0.13.0
notes.notes:
New stuff:


A nice minimap.

Some new music.

Network syncing is now smoother. Its hard to explain but you will see it.

Lots of fixes and small additions.

notes.notes:
Added:

Win conditions.

Music

Sound stuff

Some other stuff I probably forgot already.

notes.title: Version 0.11.0
notes.notes: Settting in place bedrocks for upcoming features. Lots of cool stuff added and fixed a few things. Check it out!

notes.title: Version 0.8.0 Released
notes.notes:
Changes and fixes:

Lots of small fixes.

Proper pathfinding.

Animations for units.

Synchronized peer to peer requests.

Known bugs and missing stuff:

There is a small bug with unit movement that rarely causes units to get stuck. This will be fixed in the next version.

No request buffering yet. This will be implemented in the next version. Until then you will experience a small "twitching" effect when stuff happens.
